text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It was like this last year, too, but it sure
is hot by
the sea.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I can't afford to have any
setbacks
with my conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
After all, the Sprinters Stakes is waiting
right
around the corner once summer
camp is over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unlike last year's camp, we're both more
relaxed
and not overly eager this time.
And I mean that in
a good way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of this camp by
training hard
and getting into tip-top
shape!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, my second summer camp with
Nishino
Flower gets underway.
